Get schools

Source: R/school-get.R
school_get.Rd

Returns the schools of National Land Numerical Information (学校, P29) in a year, one row per site, as published. The first call for a year downloads the file of that year's release (via ksjdata) and builds the table, which is then cached.

Usage

school_get(year)

Source

Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism, National Land Numerical Information, 学校データ (P29): https://nlftp.mlit.go.jp/ksj/gml/datalist/KsjTmplt-P29-2023.html. See data_sources() for the terms of use.

Arguments

year

Reference year (school year). See school_files() for the available years. The release of 2013 is left out, as it may not be used commercially.

Value

An sf tibble with one row per site:

  • year, release: The reference year and the year of its release, which is year.

  • city_code: 行政区域コード (P29_001) of the municipality, as published: designated cities are whole cities (for example "14100") in 2021 and wards in 2023.

  • school_code: 学校コード (P29_002), as published.

  • school_type_code: 学校分類 (P29_003): "16001" 小学校, "16002" 中学校, "16003" 中等教育学校, "16004" 高等学校, "16005" 高等専門学校, "16006" 短期大学, "16007" 大学, "16011" 幼稚園, "16012" 特別支援学校, "16013" 幼保連携型認定こども園, "16014" 義務教育学校, "16015" 各種学校, "16016" 専修学校.

  • school_name, address: 名称 and 所在地, as published. The address leaves out the municipality in 2021 and includes the prefecture and the municipality in 2023.

  • administrator_code: 管理者コード (P29_006): "1" national, "2" prefectural, "3" municipal, "4" private, "0" other.

  • closure_code: 休校区分 (P29_007): "0" not surveyed, "1" open, "2" closed, as surveyed for national and public schools up to high schools. "9" is published but not in the code list.

  • campus_code, campus_note: キャンパスコード ("00" none, "01" the main campus, and "02" onward the others) and 学校名備考, published from 2023 and NA before.

  • geometry: The school as a point, in JGD2011 (EPSG:6668).

Details

The schools are those of the School Education Act, from kindergartens to universities, specialized training colleges (専修学校), and miscellaneous schools (各種学校), and 幼保連携型認定こども園. A school with several campuses has a row for each from 2023 (campus_code), and a school and its campus identify a row. In 2021, 550 rows share their school_code with another row, and one has none.

The first time in a session, the terms of use are shown. Published or processed data must credit the source (National Land Numerical Information, 学校データ, by the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism), and processed data must say that they were processed.

See also

school_target() to declare the table as a target.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
school_get(2023)
}
